notes.title: Blood Engine v1.1.7
notes.notes:
Improved lighting and shadow system.
Improved enemy AI and laser system.
Improved enemy hit animations.
Hanging bodies are now interactable and destroyable.
Added 'infected wildlife' such as rabbits, geese and chickens.
(Because every game should have chickens!)
Added fish, such as pikes, to the lakes.
And lots of other bug fixes and improvements.
Thanks!

notes.title: Blood Engine v1.1.6
notes.notes:
Various fixes and improvements.
All achievements and now working and in the correct order!

notes.title: Blood Engine v1.1.5
notes.notes:
Many tweaks, improvements, fixes and optimizations.
Due to this, it is recommended to start a new game from the beginning with v1.1.5.
Thanks!

notes.title: Blood Engine v1.1
notes.notes:
Various fixes and improvements.
Including correct terrain tree alignment,
Improved camera and blocking systems,
arrow/w/s keys now working with the menu system.

notes.title: Blood Engine v1.0.9.9j
notes.notes:
Various small fixes and improvements.
Including improvements to the controls and melee combat system.
Health and Armour bonuses now give more HP/AP.

notes.title: Blood Engine Patch Update v1.0.9.9c | ~1.64GB Download Size
notes.notes:
Several fixes, improvements and some minor additions.
I’m sorry about the large file size. I had to re-bake some data.
Save files are not affected.

Some known issues:
Achievement 35 is currently unattainable. And the w/s/up/down keys are not currently working with the menu system. I am working on this to be fixed in a future update.

If you have any problems with the game, or would like to report a bug. Please Email me at: bloodenginehelp@hotmail.com and I’ll try me best to solve your problems as soon as possible.
Thanks!

notes.title: Blood Engine Patch Update v1.0.9.8c - 1.65GB Download Size
notes.notes:
Just some minor fixes and sound level adjustments.
I had to do a clean build, hence the large file size.
Save files are not affected.
